name: core.openwop.connections.meta-ads
description: Meta (Facebook/Instagram) Ads connection pack — OAuth2 provider for the Meta Marketing API. Reach is `openapi`: the manifest declares the global Meta OAuth hosts and points at the Marketing API reference, consumed by the core.openwop.http nodes. Carries NO secret; the operator supplies the app id/secret host-side. An available provider (the parallel ad platform to google-ads); one of the three ad platforms Campaign Studio syncs.
